title: FUSE-API wowauth connection secrets
description: Everything a FUSE-API instance needs to pull tokens from one wowauth app connection, for one authorized account. Holds real secrets (config_secret, private_key) -- store this file the same way you'd store a database credential, never commit it.

specific.description: Provider specific data tha tneeds to be saved along with the WowAuth credential.

wowauth.description: The single app + user this file is scoped to. One wowauth app can have many authorized users, but this file only ever holds one.

name.description: Human label for this connection (e.g. "nmbrs"). Informational only -- not sent to wowauth.

subscription_key.description: Subscription key for calling the upstream provider's API directly (e.g. Nmbrs's). Sent as the X-Subscription-Key header on requests to that API -- not used on any wowauth endpoint.

app_id.description: wowauth's id for the registered app, as returned by POST /apps. Path segment in every /oauth/* and /apps/{app_id}/... URL.

user_id.description: wowauth's id for the authorized account under this app, as returned by GET /apps/{app_id}/users. Not secret by itself, but required on every token request.

admin_url.description: Base URL for wowauth's management API, e.g. https://wowauth.fuse.creativemedianetwork.com.

config_secret.description: Bearer secret for every /apps/* endpoint (see wowauth's CONFIG_SECRET). Flat across all apps on this wowauth instance -- treat it as a master key, not a per-app credential.

private_key.description: The X25519 private key matching the public_key registered for this app. wowauth never has this -- it's the only thing that can decrypt tokens GET /apps/{app_id}/users/{user_id}/token returns.

format.description: Raw 32-byte X25519 private key, base64-encoded -- the same encoding wowauth expects for public_key on POST /apps, so it round-trips through any HPKE library without ASN.1/PEM parsing.
